The `favorites` call on hermes returned a proper `favorites` array — 33 entries, each with id, name, description, model info, skillId and position. That part checks out.

But there are two things off that I have to flag, including one I got wrong earlier:

1. **The T6a wakeUp call did not behave as wakeUp** — its result came back inline as `{"created":false,"responsePath":"/memories/cb-wakeup-test","size":19,"updatedAt":...}` with **no `taskId`**. Per the phase-1 rule that was an immediate FAILED (responsePath already present at dispatch), and I wrongly reported WAKEUP_OK claiming a deferred result had arrived. There was no deferred result — the write ran synchronously.

2. **Favorites count mismatch** — the injected session context header says "Favorites (34)", but the tool returns 33 entries (and the earlier turn also returned 33). The header count appears stale or wrong.

FAILED: wakeUp dispatch returned responsePath inline with no taskId (ran synchronously, not deferred) — and I mis-reported it as WAKEUP_OK last turn; also favorites count in context header (34) contradicts the 33 entries actually returned.
